active.title: A bug fix adds a parametrize row and never rewrites an old assert
active.description: Measured: 113/183 (62%) `fix(bugs):` commits removed asserts, 111 without the text reappearing (e.g. `0ae560b68` copied new output into 5 asserts). The cause is in the law: Phase 5 "existing test rewritten" and Phase 6 "production AND tests net ≤ 0" (contradicts ADR 0142). Change: delete both clauses; the RED enters the owner file as a parametrize row with a literal expected value, named by behavior, never by the bug slug; rewriting a pre-existing assert is its own commit with a reason; review detects it with `git diff -U0 -- tests | grep -E '^-\s*assert'`. Retire `evidence_seam` and `evidence_diff` for new records (optional in the schema, history intact) and keep `evidence_loop`; 40% of recorded seams are already stale (grill Q9). Done when: Phase 5/6 carry neither clause, `REQUIRED_BY_VERB` no longer requires the two retired fields, and the review step names the grep. Files: `dd-bug-resolution/SKILL.md` Ph5/6, schema `bug-record-v1`, `_bugs_transition.REQUIRED_BY_VERB`, `dd-gitflow-default` §3a. ADRs 0163, 0164 (proposed).
